title: Yellow Fever Vaccine
overview: Yellow fever vaccine is a live, weakened virus. It is given as a single shot. For people who remain at risk, a booster dose is recommended every 10 years.

sections.Yellow fever is a serious disease caused: fever and flu-like symptomsjaundice (yellow skin or eyes)bleeding from multiple body sitesliver, kidney, respiratory and other organ failuredeath (20 to 50% of serious cases)Yellow fever vaccine is a live, weakened virus. It is given as a single shot. For people who remain at risk, a booster dose is recommended every 10 years.Yellow fever vaccine may be given at the same time as most other vaccines.
